Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: In the initial search for "Who was the first governor general of India?", WebSurfer encountered conflicting information from multiple sources, stating Warren Hastings as the first Governor-General of India in 1784 and Lord William Bentinck as the first official Governor-General of British India. WebSurfer failed to clarify the distinction between the titles "Governor-General of India" and "Governor-General of British India," which led to ambiguity in understanding the correct position of Warren Hastings. This lack of clarification set the foundation for subsequent errors in interpreting the historical context and answering the real-world problem accurately.
